note: Checks that check:all skips (reported as KNOWN). REAL_GAP: a real limitation, with what it means for the app. HELPER: a script another check runs with arguments, not a check on its own. Triaged in Phase 5.5 (2026-11-26); the other inherited failures were fixed or deleted, see docs/AUDIT-AND-ROADMAP.md.

scripts.name: lafea-b01-negative-route-check.mjs
scripts.reason: The direct LAFEA.3 continuum route accepts an inverted T3 element and misplaced T6/Q8 midside nodes, and keeps a result accepted after its source changes (4 of 16 negative cases). Meshes made by the app's mesher pass its own quality gate first; a hand-imported mesh does not. Needs python3.

scripts.name: lafea-b02-definition-freeze-check.mjs
scripts.reason: The B02A benchmark definition no longer matches the bytes recorded when it was frozen (it was edited upstream afterwards). The B02A-C production runs it protects cannot run here.

scripts.name: lafea-b02d-production-check.mjs
scripts.reason: Full B02D lug-pinhole production run (T3, T6 and Q8 at four levels). It timed out upstream at 120 s and did not finish in 30 minutes here, so whether it passes is not established. Too slow for check:all; run it alone with --include-known --timeout=<ms>.

scripts.name: lafea-b02d-v2-production-check.mjs
scripts.reason: Same full production run on the V2 polar mesh; also timed out upstream. The V2 governing-response check (about 2 minutes) does run in check:all.

scripts.name: lafea-bucket-01-cantilever-check.mjs
scripts.reason: The Jacobi-preconditioned CG solver stalls on the slender fine-mesh cantilever: residual 1.2e-8 against a 1.1e-10 target after 34,816 iterations. A slender plate in the app's plate form could hit the same limit.

scripts.name: lafea-plane-strain-bbar-lame-check.mjs
scripts.reason: Same Jacobi-PCG stall as the cantilever, on the plane-strain B-bar thick cylinder (ITERATIVE_SOLVER_DID_NOT_CONVERGE).

scripts.name: lafea-shell-curved-hole-ladder-check.mjs
scripts.reason: The LAFEA.4 shell mesh producer blocks on mesh quality for a curved shell with a hole. Only the full LAFEA.4 workbench uses this producer; the WRC FE cross-check builds its own nozzle mesh.

scripts.name: lafea-shell-hole-ladder-check.mjs
scripts.reason: The LAFEA.4 shell mesh producer blocks on mesh quality for a flat shell with a rectangular hole at target size 25. Not used by the app (see lafea-shell-curved-hole-ladder-check).

scripts.name: lafea-shell-hole-mesh-check.mjs
scripts.reason: The LAFEA.4 shell mesh producer does not qualify a shell-with-hole mesh the check expects to pass. Not used by the app (see lafea-shell-curved-hole-ladder-check).

scripts.name: lafea-tech4-curved-hole-convergence-check.mjs
scripts.reason: The curved-hole shell midsurface contract rejects its own point keys (LAFEA_SHELL_CURVED_HOLE_POINT_KEYS_INVALID). Not used by the app (see lafea-shell-curved-hole-ladder-check).

scripts.name: lafea.4-a4-thickness-applicability-check.mjs
scripts.reason: The experimental MITC4 shell element fails its own recovery-energy check at t/L = 0.001. The app's shell FE uses CST+DKT, not MITC.

scripts.name: lafea.4-production-adoption-aggregate-check.mjs
scripts.reason: Runs lafea.4-a4-thickness-applicability-check (the MITC gap above); its other gates run on their own in check:all.
